title.narrative: Empowering women and strengthening the resilience of vulnerable rural and urban communities in South Lebanon and Beirut

description.narrative: Direct target group: 14,500 persons (60% women, 3% people with disabilities), including:(a) 140 persons (70% women), training in urban agriculture.(b) 210 smallholder farmers (40% women), training in agricultural productivity.(c) Support for 213 women-led enterprises (165 MSMEs, 18 cooperatives, 30 start-ups).(d) 1,170 persons (60% women) are supported through CfW: 630 in the area of food processing, 540 (60% women) in the area of agriculture, 11,800 persons receive food parcels (50% women).(e) 720 participants in peacebuilding trainings and meetings, PSEA and PSS (60% women); 10 local CBOs supported in social cohesion activities (among others: Al Riaya, Mouwasat, Al Imam El Sader, LWAH...).Indirect target group: approx. 42,500 persons

Project Objective: Strengthening women's livelihoods and increasing the resilience of vulnerable communities engaged in smallholder and subsistence agriculture.Outcomes: (1) Agricultural and urban target groups have sustainably increased income through expanded skills.(2) Women-led MSMEs, cooperatives and start-ups improve their economic performance.(3) Social cohesion and relationships between communities with different backgrounds are strengthened.

The project aims at strengthening women’s livelihoods and increasing the resilience of vulnerable communities involved in smallholder farming and subsistence agriculture by supporting them in adopting enhanced farming and food solutions, and by developing the business sustainability of Women-led MSMEs, COOPs and startups, while increasing the social cohesion between communities with different backgrounds. The project will include activities such as: Capacity building with a focus on women leadership, In-kind support, food parcels distribution, linkages and work with local CBOs, CFW, social cohesion & protection services.
